parameters.formDescription: Tell us about your project. Your message is saved before enrichment starts. Replace this notice with your business contact and configured retention before publishing.

values.option: I acknowledge the privacy notice and agree to processing for this inquiry.

parameters.completionMessage: Your message has been saved. Our team will review it and get back to you.

parameters.content:
## LeadHarbor · Save first, enrich in the background
1. Start the app service.
2. Set the HTTP Header Auth credential on Save submission durably: Authorization = Bearer <INGEST_TOKEN>.
3. Docker uses http://app:8080. For n8n Cloud, use your HTTPS app origin.
4. Customize the privacy notice and publish the form.
5. Set this workflow’s Error workflow to the imported LeadHarbor error handler.

The durable service handles validation, idempotency, safe website fetching, strict AI output, retries, CRM, and the dashboard. Receipt is confirmed only after the database commits.

No credentials are embedded. See docs/N8N.md. For Docker, the internal app hostname is narrowly allowlisted for n8n SSRF protection.
